{{BossList|Default}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Summon}}''' - The '''Creator''' spawns [[Bruh]]s, [[SCT]]s and [[Glitched Giant]]s. |ability2 = '''{{WikiAb|Stomp}}''' - The '''Creator''' stomps, creating a shockwave that stuns towers. |ability3 = '''{{WikiAb|Lightning}}''' - The '''Creator''' creates purple lightning bolts above towers, stunning the selected towers that are struck. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Creator''' was a major boss that appeared in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Legacy Hidden Wave]]. Because of that, this boss could only be fought in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. For a major boss, the '''Creator''' moved quite quickly and had an insane amount of health that will test even the most experienced of players. The '''Creator''' could spawn [[enemies]] that could easily overwhelm you if you were not careful. It was also immune to being burnt by the [[Pyromancer]], being stunned by the [[Electroshocker]], being frozen by the [[Freezer]], [[Frost Blaster]] or Level 3+ [[Sledger]], and being slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]]. ==Appearance== The '''Creator''' looked like one of BelowNatural's past avatars, the creator of the game, hence the name. It wore a dark purple Viking helmet, a black reflective bow-tie and has glowing purple eyes. It had reflective black skin and appeared to be faceless, aside from the glowing eyes. It wore a granite waistcoat that was dark blue, grey and purple. Its torso was granite purple while its legs were black granite. It had dark purple elbow-pads and two different gloves; one glove was the standard fingerless glove that most towers and enemies use and was also dark purple, while the other glove was longer and appeared to have fingers and was also black. It had dark grey knee-pads and black boots. It had twisted metal protruding from its lower torso and right leg. ==Strategy== *Use what you would to defeat a very strong boss. This includes {{Color|Golden}} [[Minigunner]]s, [[Ranger]]s, [[Turret]]s and [[Accelerator]]s. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] are a must for this boss, as they all support towers in defeating the '''Creator'''. If possible, try to constantly have the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability always active. *The '''Creator''' is immune to being frozen by the [[Freezer]], [[Sledger]] and [[Frost Blaster]], and being stunned by the [[Electroshocker]]. It is also immune to being slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]]. None of these towers except the [[Electroshocker]] can slow down the '''Creator'''. They can however, be useful at slowing down the enemies summoned by the '''Creator'''. ** The '''Creator''' is also immune to burn damage from the [[Pyromancer]], though normal (non-burn) damage can still harm it. However, as the [[Pyromancer]] deals very little non-burn damage, it is recommended to sell it once the '''Creator''' appears. *The '''Creator''' can spawn [[enemies]] with incredibly high amounts of health, such as the [[Glitched Giant]]. Make sure you deal with them alongside the '''Creator'''. *The '''Creator''' can stun towers with its ''Stomp'' and ''Lightning'' move. If you have a tower slot for it, consider using the [[Medic]]'s ability. **Cliff towers, like the [[Ranger]], can be stunned by the ''Stomp'' ability despite them being immune to most other stomps. **[[Units]] are not harmed by the '''Creator's''' ''Stomp''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} CreatorIconIG.png|'''Creator''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Creator''' is a reference to [https://www.roblox.com/users/16983447/profile BelowNatural]'s [https://twitter.com/BelowNatural/status/1266471564867969027 "official" outfit]. *When the '''Creator''' spawned, it waved its arms in the air and screams. **This was somewhat similar to the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Void|Void]] from ''Tower Battles''. == Update History == *'''25 November 2019''' - [[Release v1.3|Release v1.3.0]] **'''Creator''' added. *'''27 November 2019''' - [[Release v1.3|Release v1.3.0a]] **Health increased from 250,000 to 300,000. *'''27 November 2019''' - [[Release v1.3|Release v1.3.0b]] **Health increased from 300,000 to 500,000. *'''27 November 2019''' - [[Release v1.3|Release v1.3.0c]] **Health increased from 500,000 to 750,000. **Speed increased from Extremely Slow to Slow. *'''29 November 2019''' - [[Release v1.4|Release v1.4.0]] **Health decreased from 750,000 to 600,000. **Speed decreased from Slow to Very Slow (1.25). **[[Burn Immunity]] and [[Freeze Immunity]] added. **Now is a [[Boss]] enemy. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **[[Energy Immunity]] added. **Summoned enemies no longer give money when damaged. **{{Bug}} '''Stomp''' ability's animation did not play; shockwave created was not visible. *'''4 July 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.4|Overhaul v1.4.0]] **'''Creator''' can no longer be slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]]. *'''4 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]] **'''Creator''' removed. *'''12 February 2025''' - [[v1.53.0|v1.53.3a]] **'''Creator''' now appears in the legacy [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]], which is exclusive to [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **''Summon'' can no longer summon [[Developer 1]], [[Developer 2]] and [[Developer 3]]. **Due to changes made with updates, [[Energy Immunity]] has been replaced with [[Stun Immunity]]. **{{Bugfix}} '''Stomp''' ability animation works again; shockwave is also now visible again. *'''12 February 2025''' - [[v1.53.0|v1.53.3b]] **'''Creator''' no longer appears in the legacy [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]], as it has been removed. {{HiddenWave|[[Mechanical Rot (Legacy)|Mechanical Rot]]|Creator|[[A]]}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]]
